title: $1000 per day untill $100,000 loan with BitConnect, by Michael Crypto
description: Get started with Bitconnect - https://bitconnect.co/?ref=jfs001 Bitconnect started on 2016-02-09 and is an open source all in one ...

asr.full_text: there it is 1,025 dollars and write down here four days I've earned 3,633 dollars and 76 cents I can take my bitcoin out at anytime whatsoever i was a trader I did foreign currency it was a stockbroker you know I don't know what I don't know what to say, it works this 1,025 dollars and.60 I got in 24 hours. I can transfer it to my BitConnect wallet. The BitConnect wallet can then go to my bitcoin wallet. I'm familiar with autobots. Banks use autobots. This is an autobot. They deal with the volatility. I'm not going to lose my money. It's a loan, it's lending, and it's just growing. Every day I give myself a loan. In fact, I don't think $1,025 is enough, so I'm going to go to my lending wallet. I'm going to reinvest that bad boy. I'm going to go in here. I'm putting it all in because I'll do better tomorrow. I'm going to do that up to $100,000. I'll get there way before the summer's over, and then some real funds will start coming in. $2,000, $3,000 depending. Reinvest. I keep my money for a little while. That's fine. Keep it. What I mean by that is you get your original investment back over a period of time. You'll get it back. So there we go. I just gave myself a raise down here. I've almost earned $5,000 in less than four days.

textual.observation: BitConnect is presented with a promised return of $1,000 per day and a loan amount up to $100,000, alongside an instruction to get started through a referral URL.

evidence.quote: $1000 per day untill $100,000 loan with BitConnect

textual.context: The title and description present this as a promotional or onboarding message. The source records do not establish whether the speaker is endorsing the service, demonstrating it, or discussing it critically.
textual.potential_relevance: The requested action to get started through a referral URL is directly associated with a high-return and large-loan claim, creating a reward-and-action relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether the advertised returns or loan are available, accurate, guaranteed, or received by viewers. The referral URL and destination were not independently verified.

textual.observation: The speaker describes receiving approximately $1,025 in 24 hours and nearly $5,000 in less than four days, then says they will reinvest the funds toward $100,000.

textual.limitations: The records do not verify the amounts, timing, account activity, underlying terms, or whether the reported earnings represent profit, principal, credits, or another balance.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes BitConnect as a route to unusually rapid returns and directs viewers to start through a referral URL. The speaker links a reported $1,025.60 received in 24 hours to reinvesting toward $100,000, and describes sending $1,010 to BitConnect Robot trading with capital release after 239 days. The records do not independently verify the earnings, transfer, or later release.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The central flow places funds in a lending wallet and links reinvestment to daily profit and return of capital. The speaker also expects better results after reinvesting. The speaker links an autobot to the growing lending investment, and the confirmation screen identifies BitConnect Robot trading as the destination for a proposed reinvestment.
